versions.changelog:
- Initial public release of the "US Tech Giant Analyst" skill.
- Provides an in-depth, data-rich analysis of major US-listed technology companies such as Apple, Microsoft, Nvidia, Amazon, Alphabet, Meta, and Tesla.
- Delivers a visually structured HTML report, including a six-section company analysis, core summary, valuation table, risk matrix, and multiple inline charts.
- Requires every figure to be sourced and dated, with explicit disclosure of any missing data.
- Designed to answer user requests for company fundamentals, earnings, competitive position, stock performance, and comparisons between big tech firms.
